description:
The x402 service catalog. Without `q` it is ordered by the catalog's own reported 30-day call count (reported by the source, not indexed by Roundhouse); with `q` it is a relevance search grouped by service, so a mirror host or a listing repeated by several directories is one result. Each row carries the verified volume of the SERVICE it belongs to (settlements a known facilitator relayed, summed over every wallet the service accepts payment at, since `volume_since`), because a settlement carries no resource URL: the figure repeats on each of a service's endpoints and is not that endpoint's own. `concentrated` is true when one payer is at least half of 30-day volume, and `shared_pay_to` when the wallet serves many unrelated listings. A listing is a claim; the observed columns are evidence, so prefer `is_live` with non-zero `l30_unique_payers`. Note the path stays `/v0/endpoints` although the human page moved to `/services`; renaming it would break published integrations.

Wraps GET /v0/endpoints.
Access: no API key required.

Returns:
- endpoints: Catalog rows with price, network, payTo, liveness and observed demand.
- next_offset: Offset for the next page, or `null` when this page was the last.
- meta: The chain served and `as_of`. On an EMPTY list it also carries `dataset_last_written_at`, `dataset_row_count` and any `warnings` (e.g. `endpoints_catalog_stale`) — so a zero can be read as a quiet market or a stalled ingest rather than guessed at.

fields.description: `compact` returns name, resource, price, network, payTo and liveness only — no description, icon or tags — which is roughly a third of the payload.

group.description: `endpoint` (default) returns one endpoint per matched service. `service` returns `services`, each with its `endpoints` (up to six matches) and the service's volume, for a caller that wants the whole service.

limit.description: Rows to return. Clamped to 200; values outside the range are clamped, not rejected.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Use the returned `next_offset`.

q.description: Free-text search over name, description, tags, the service's own web description and the URL's host and path words. Every word must match (any word, when none does), and related terms are expanded, so `virtual card` and `send bank payment` find a card or payout service whose name says neither. Results are one per service.

name: list_services
title: Indexed x402 service directory
